questions.question: The number 611611611611 is: (a)divisible by both 6 and 11 (b)neither divisible by 6 nor by 11 (c)divisible by 6 only (d)divisible by 11 only
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number is 611611611611.

**Formula used:**

Divisibility Rules:

1. A number is divisible by 6 if it is divisible by both 2 and 3.

2. A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of the digits in the odd positions and the sum of the digits in the even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculation:**

Check for divisibility by 6:

1. Divisibility by 2: The last digit is 1, which is not even. Hence, 611611611611 is not divisible by 2.

2. Divisibility by 3: Sum of the digits = 6 + 1 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 6 + 1 + 1 = 32. Since 32 is not divisible by 3, 611611611611 is not divisible by 3.

Since the number is not divisible by both 2 and 3, it is not divisible by 6.

questions.question: A right angled triangle of area 600 m² is to be made such that the hypotenuse is double the base. For the triangle, the hypotenuse is ________ more than the base.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of the right-angled triangle = 600 m²

Hypotenuse = 2 × Base

Hypotenuse > Base

**Formula used:**

Area of right-angled triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height

Pythagoras theorem: Hypotenuse² = Base² + Height²

**Calculation:**

Let the base be b meters.

Height = h meters.

Hypotenuse = 2b meters.

Area = (1/2) × b × h

600 = (1/2) × b × h

⇒ h = 1200 / b

Using Pythagoras theorem:

(2b)² = b² + (1200 / b)²

⇒ 4b² = b² + 1440000 / b²

⇒ 3b⁴ = 1440000

⇒ b⁴ = 480000

⇒ b² = 692.82

⇒ b = 26.32 m

Hypotenuse = 2 × 26.32 = 52.64 m

Difference between hypotenuse and base = 52.64 - 26.32 = 26.32 m.

Therefore, hypotenuse is 26.32 m more than the base.

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Thee 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of Indian Constitution was passed in the year ________.

__
 
• The **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act** of the Indian Constitution was passed in the year **1976**.
 
• This amendment is also known as the **Mini-Constitution** due to the extensive changes it brought to the Constitution of India.
 
• It was enacted during the Emergency period and brought about several significant changes to the Constitution, including the addition of the words **"Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity"** to the Preamble.
 
• The 42nd Amendment also curtailed the power of judicial review and made substantial changes to the legislative and executive powers at both the central and state levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The Seventh Schedule of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the Union, State, and Concurrent lists.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in Article 368.
 
• The 42nd Amendment has been a subject of much debate and has had a lasting impact on the Indian political and legal landscape.
